params.body:
Four findings from Frederik (2026-09-15, 13:10), one PR.

## 1. A step change scrolls to the head of the sheet

After scrolling down on the Data step and clicking Volgende, the page stayed at the foot of a step that was no longer there. Every step change (tab, Volgende, Vorige) now scrolls the head of the sheet into view after the Livewire response, when that head is above the viewport: the stepper on a desk, the step header on a phone, under the fixed top bar; `auto` instead of `smooth` for prefers-reduced-motion. A click on the visible stepper does not jump. Rule S1-9.19.

## 2. Car-Pass warning on publishing

Checked every path that turns publishing on:

- Portal switch in the list (the only path that sets `send_to_modix`): already shows "Uw wagen wordt doorgestuurd zonder Car-Pass. Uw zoekertje kan door de portaalsite's worden verwijderd." as the description under the question (PR 415). Verified in the browser, screenshot below. S2-4.3 goes from "betwist" to confirmed.
- "Publiceren op stocklist" in the list: already warns.
- "Publiceren op stocklist" on the sheet: asked nothing. Now the same confirmation as the list when the vehicle has no Car-Pass; with Car-Pass the panel stays the confirmation.
- The Stocklist tick on the Data step saves with the sheet, so it says "(Carpass werd nog niet doorgestuurd!)" beside the tick while it is on without Car-Pass.

The wording itself is unchanged (Ilse's call). Rule S2-1.7 updated.

## 3. NOx persists (and Euronorm, WLTP, NEDC, fiscale pk, battery)

Root cause: the Milieu block sits inside the option island of the sheet. That island posts `option[...]` changes by AJAX; the seven vehicle columns in it were plain inputs nothing posted, and `toBackendArray()` took them from the draft row. So a typed NOx was shown, "saved", and gone; the Energy Card kept saying "niet beschikbaar".

Now wired to `VehicleForm` (properties, `wiredKeys`, step Eigenschappen for the error jump), `:wire` on the inputs in Livewire mode only (`$lw`, the classic form posts them as before), Dutch decimals through `OwnStockService::DECIMALS` ("12,5" stored as 12.5), `nullable|numeric` for NOx, fiscale pk and battery in `VehicleRequest::rulesFor` (a double column refuses "abc" with a 500).

One deliberate choice, recorded as an open question in the finding: WLTP/NEDC are checked for format only on this sheet (`VehicleForm::wiredRules`). The classic form required one of the two for a non-export vehicle; the sheet never did (it did not know the fields), so requiring them today would refuse saves that worked yesterday. Ilse decides whether the requirement returns; dropping `wiredRules` brings it back. Rule S1-9.20.

## 4. The offer shows its relation

Reproduced locally: after picking a relation, `relation_id` was filled and `relation_name` stayed "". The hidden `relation_id` of the offer form carries `onchange="calculateFlexleasePriceAll()"`, a function that only exists when the FlexLease rows are on the page; without FlexLease the change event the shared picker fires threw a ReferenceError, and since the picker fired that event before writing the name, the handler stopped after the id. Fix: the handler is guarded with `typeof`, and `slRelatieNaarModal` writes the name and the takeover list before it triggers `change`. Same picker serves the order and rental forms. Rule S4-2.20.

## Tests

`VehicleFormSaveTest` (+2: Milieu round-trip incl. the Energy Card check, missing emissions do not block / a bad number does), `VehicleFormSheetMarkupTest` (new: scroll handler, Car-Pass confirm on the sheet's Publiceren button with and without Car-Pass, Data-step hint), `OfferRelationPickerTest` (new: guarded onchange, name before trigger). Filter `VehicleForm|Offer|Relation|Carpass|OwnStockRowMarkup|Affiche|HandlerWiring|AlpineExpression|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|CompiledViews|StylesheetSyntax|Nox` green locally.

## Screenshots (`.playwright-mcp/frederik-round/` in the worktree)

- `offer-relation-before.png` (name empty) vs `offer-relation-after-1440.png`, `offer-relation-after-390.png` (Jan Peeters shown)
- `nox-after-reload-1440.png` (12.5 back in the box after save and reload)
- `step-before-next-1440.png` / `step-after-next-1440.png`, `step-after-next-390.png`
- `sheet-publish-carpass-confirm-1440.png`, `-390.png`
- `publish-confirm-before.png` (the row switch, already showing the portal warning)

Findings: `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-{nox-blijft-niet-staan,offerte-toont-gekozen-relatie-niet,stapwissel-scrolt-niet-naar-boven,carpass-waarschuwing-bij-publiceren}.md`.

## Addendum: the stocklist detail page

Shane's screenshots were the "Offerte maken" modal on the STOCKLIST DETAIL of a colleague's vehicle, with a second symptom: the picker's "Sélection" buttons did nothing. Reproduced: `detail.blade.php` included the picker partial AFTER `@endsection`, and Blade prints what is outside every section before the layout, so the partial's script ran before jQuery ("$ is not defined"), `slRelatieNaarModal` never existed and `fill_in_relation` failed on every choice. The include now stands inside the content section, and the partial binds its jQuery events only once jQuery is there. Verified in the browser: pick closes the picker, id and name land in the offer (`detail-offer-relation-after.png`, `detail-picker-after.png`). Test: `OfferRelationPickerTest::test_the_stocklist_detail_page_loads_the_picker_after_jquery`.

NOx re-checked in the browser with this branch: type and click Opslaan directly (no separate blur) -> 7,25 and 12,5 come back exactly after a reload. Shane's re-test was on staging, before this PR. One open point in the finding: the column is `double(15,2)`, so a value typed in g/km ("0,0125") is stored as 0.01; the box says mg/km. Widening the column is a migration on the vehicles table and deliberately not done today.
params.title: Sheet scrolls to the step, NoX persists, Car-Pass warning on publishing, offer shows its relation
